expect_red: an edge name's ` -- ` is part of the NAME: a chain row is shown whole while an excluded term beside it still splits

mutations.contract: VA.STUDY_FINDING_SOURCES says, per gap kind, whether the strings in that bucket follow the ` -- ` split convention. Only the excluded-terms bucket does; the other two hold edge names, whose own ` -- ` is part of the name.
mutations.note: The guard asserts BOTH halves of one rule -- names whole, terms still split -- so either half alone leaves the other unwitnessed, which is why this spec carries two mutations. This one puts the two name-carrying buckets back to splitting: a chain row whose edge name contains ` -- ` is cut in half. Measured in review of findings_splitter_scopes_to_excluded_terms (2026-09-22) at 496/497, and replayed here before it was declared.
